REGULATION (EU) No 575/2013 (CRR) - ARTICLE 26(2) - INCLUSION OF INTERIM OR YEAR-END PROFITS

2. For the purposes of point (c) of paragraph 1, institutions may include interim or year-end profits in Common Equity Tier 1 capital before the institution has taken a formal decision confirming the final profit or loss of the institution for the year, only if they meet the following conditions:

(a) those profits have been verified by persons independent of the institution that are responsible for the auditing of the accounts of that institution; AND

(b) the institution has demonstrated to the satisfaction of the competent authority that any foreseeable charge or dividend has been deducted from the amount of those profits.

A verification of the interim or year-end profits of the institution and the assignment of those profits to Common Equity Tier 1 capital shall be adequate to the assurance provided by the external auditor that the interim or year-end profits have been audited in accordance with International Standards on Auditing.

COREP TEMPLATE C 01.00 - OWN FUNDS
Reporting Instructions (Sample)
Version: 2024-09
Jurisdiction: UK
Page 1 of 3

Template C 01.00 is used for reporting on own funds in accordance with Part Two
of Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 (CRR) as amended and applicable in the UK.

The template captures the composition and calculation of own funds, broken down
into Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1), Additional Tier 1 (AT1), and Tier 2 (T2) capital.

Own funds calculated as: Tier 1 capital + Tier 2 capital
Tier 1 capital = CET1 capital + AT1 capital

All amounts shall be reported in GBP thousands.

Row 0010 - Own funds total
Definition: The total amount of own funds as calculated pursuant to Article 72 CRR.
Calculation: Sum of row 0060 (Total Tier 1 capital) and row 0200 (Tier 2 capital).
Legal reference: Article 72 CRR
Template: C 01.00

Row 0020 - Tier 1 capital total
Also referenced as row 0060 in some versions.
Definition: The sum of Common Equity Tier 1 capital and Additional Tier 1 capital.
Calculation: Row 0050 + row 0140
Legal reference: Article 25 CRR
Template: C 01.00

Row 0030 - Common Equity Tier 1 capital elements
Definition: Capital instruments eligible as CET1 capital pursuant to Article 28 CRR.
Legal reference: Article 26, Article 28 CRR
Template: C 01.00

Row 0050 - Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) capital total
Definition: Total CET1 capital after all regulatory adjustments and deductions.
Legal reference: Article 50 CRR
Template: C 01.00

Row 0070 - Own CET1 instruments held by the institution
Definition: Direct, indirect and synthetic holdings by the institution of own CET1 instruments.
These amounts are deducted from CET1.
Legal reference: Article 36(1)(f) CRR
Template: C 01.00

Row 0130 - Retained earnings
Definition: Retained earnings of the institution including interim or year-end profits
that have been verified by persons independent of the institution.
Legal reference: Article 26(1)(c) CRR
Template: C 01.00

Row 0200 - Tier 2 (T2) capital total
Definition: Total Tier 2 capital after regulatory adjustments and deductions.
Legal reference: Article 71 CRR
Template: C 01.00

Row 0290 - Prudent valuation adjustment / Additional Valuation Adjustments (AVAs)
Definition: The difference between the accounting value and the prudent value,
calculated in accordance with Article 105 CRR.
Legal reference: Article 34, Article 105 CRR
Template: C 01.00

Row 0300 - Goodwill
Definition: Intangible asset goodwill as valued pursuant to applicable accounting framework.
This amount is deducted from CET1.
Legal reference: Article 36(1)(b) CRR, Article 4(1)(113) CRR
Template: C 01.00

Row 0140 - Additional Tier 1 (AT1) capital total
Definition: Total Additional Tier 1 capital after regulatory adjustments.
Legal reference: Article 61 CRR
Template: C 01.00

Column 0010 - Amount
Definition: The regulatory capital amount in GBP thousands for each row item.
All values shall be reported as positive unless explicitly marked as deductions.

Rule VR_C01_001: Own funds total (row 0010) must equal the sum of Tier 1 (row 0020/0060)
and Tier 2 (row 0200).
Severity: ERROR

Rule VR_C01_002: Tier 1 capital (row 0020/0060) must equal the sum of CET1 (row 0050)
and AT1 (row 0140).
Severity: ERROR

Rule VR_C01_003: Deduction items (including rows 0070, 0290, 0300) must be applied
with the correct sign to reduce capital amounts.
Severity: WARNING

Rule VR_C01_004: Prudent valuation adjustments (row 0290) must not exceed 10% of
net trading book assets where applicable.
Severity: WARNING

text:
Template C 07.00 captures exposures subject to credit risk under the Standardised
Approach as defined in Part Three, Title II, Chapter 2 of Regulation (EU) No 575/2013
(CRR) as applicable in the UK.

Exposures are classified according to Article 112 CRR exposure classes and risk-weighted
according to the applicable risk weights under the Standardised Approach.

The template includes both on-balance sheet and off-balance sheet exposures, with
separate treatment for exposures in default, secured by mortgages on immovable property,
and items subject to specific prudential treatments.

Row 0010 - Central governments or central banks
Definition: Exposures to central governments or central banks as defined in Article
114 CRR, risk-weighted according to Articles 114-116 CRR.
Exposure class: Central governments or central banks (Article 112(a) CRR)
Template: C 07.00

Row 0040 - Institutions
Definition: Exposures to institutions as defined in Article 119 CRR.
Risk-weighted according to Articles 119-121 CRR.
Exposure class: Institutions (Article 112(c) CRR)
Template: C 07.00

Row 0080 - Off-balance sheet exposures not in default
Definition: Off-balance sheet items listed in Annex I CRR that are subject to credit risk.
IMPORTANT: This row shall NOT include exposures arising from derivative instruments or
from repurchase transactions, securities or commodities lending or borrowing transactions,
or margin lending transactions (collectively referred to as CCR exposures).
Legal reference: Article 166(8) CRR, Annex I CRR
Template: C 07.00

Row 0090 - Retail exposures secured by mortgages on immovable property
Definition: Retail exposures secured by mortgages on residential or commercial immovable
property, subject to conditions in Articles 123-124 CRR.
Exposure class: Retail exposures (Article 112(f) CRR)
Risk weights: Dependent on loan-to-value and property type.
Template: C 07.00

Row 0120 - Exposures in default
Definition: Exposures meeting the definition of default under Article 178 CRR. These
include exposures where the obligor is past due more than 90 days or is unlikely to
pay its credit obligations.
Risk weight: 100% or 150% depending on level of provisions (Article 127 CRR)
Legal reference: Article 127, Article 178 CRR
Template: C 07.00

Row 0150 - Equity exposures
Definition: Exposures to equity instruments and holdings that qualify as equities
for regulatory purposes under Article 133 CRR.
Risk weight: Typically 100%, 250%, or 370% depending on type and conditions.
Legal reference: Article 133 CRR
Template: C 07.00

Row 0170 - Securitisation positions
Definition: Exposures arising from securitisation as defined in Article 4(1)(61) CRR,
subject to specific treatment under Part Three, Title II, Chapter 5 CRR.
Legal reference: Articles 242-270 CRR
Template: C 07.00

Row 0290 - Of which: exposures secured by mortgages on immovable property - risk weight 35%
Definition: Memorandum item. Subset of exposures secured by mortgages on residential
immovable property attracting a 35% risk weight under Article 125(2) CRR.
Note: This is a memorandum row and amounts should not be double-counted in totals.
Template: C 07.00

Row 0300 - Of which: exposures secured by mortgages on immovable property - risk weight 100%
Definition: Memorandum item. Subset of exposures secured by mortgages (typically commercial
property) attracting a 100% risk weight.
Template: C 07.00

Row 0320 - Of which: exposures in default with risk weight 150%
Definition: Memorandum item. Exposures in default where the value of provisions is
less than 20% of the exposure value, attracting a 150% risk weight per Article 127(2) CRR.
Template: C 07.00

Column 0010 - Original exposure pre conversion factors
Definition: The nominal or accounting value of the exposure before application of credit
conversion factors (for off-balance sheet items) and before credit risk mitigation.

Column 0040 - Exposure value
Definition: The exposure value after application of conversion factors and credit risk
mitigation techniques, calculated pursuant to Articles 111 and 166-168 CRR.

Column 0070 - Risk weight (%)
Definition: The applicable risk weight percentage under the Standardised Approach.

Column 0080 - Risk-weighted exposure amounts (RWA)
Definition: The product of exposure value (column 0040) and risk weight (column 0070),
representing the risk-weighted amount for own funds requirements calculation.

Exposures shall be assigned to exposure classes in accordance with Article 112 CRR
following this decision ordering:

1. First check if exposure is a securitisation position (row 0170)
2. Then check if exposure is to central government/central bank (row 0010)
3. Then check if exposure is to an institution (row 0040)
4. Then check if exposure meets definition of default (row 0120)
5. Then check if exposure is equity (row 0150)
6. Then apply retail, corporate, or other classification as appropriate

Rule VR_C07_001: Off-balance sheet exposures (row 0080) must not include CCR-related
items (derivatives, repos, securities lending).
Severity: ERROR
Legal reference: Article 166(8) CRR

Rule VR_C07_002: Exposures in default (row 0120) cannot simultaneously be classified
as equities (row 0150).
Severity: ERROR

Rule VR_C07_003: Memorandum rows (0290, 0300, 0320) must be subsets of their parent rows
and shall not be added to totals.
Severity: ERROR

Rule VR_C07_004: Risk-weighted exposure amounts (column 0080) should equal exposure
value (column 0040) multiplied by risk weight (column 0070).
Severity: WARNING
Tolerance: ±1% for rounding

Rule VR_C07_005: If scenario indicates property-secured exposure, rows 0090, 0290,
or 0300 should be populated.
Severity: WARNING

Rule VR_C07_006: Off-balance sheet exposures (row 0080) require conversion factors
per Annex I CRR (typically 20%, 50%, or 100%).
Severity: WARNING
